annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes paying a $99 membership fee and $500 or more for mining-pool shares while presenting recurring, compounding income as the benefit. He also links additional earnings to recruiting others and directly invites viewers to contact him for more information, making this an active solicitation rather than neutral commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because paid memberships and mining-pool shares are explicitly linked to recurring Bitcoin mining income and automatic reinvestment. S06 is additionally supported by the speaker's description of a multi-level marketing and recruiting income stream, including more than $1,000 in reported earnings from that activity.
